messages:
elaine s: Quick sync - BeaconHealth POC kickoff. Need agreement on: sample payload (they prefer JSONL), redaction policy, sandbox network option, and measurable success criteria. Can infra/security confirm feasibility?

rob m: We can stand up a JSONL S3 bucket + short-lived creds. Default infra: 1x GPU, no autoscale. Need sample size and peak QPS to size.

nina s: Security: they require KMS encryption, audit logs, and an NDA addendum for sample PHI-like data. Full SAML is out of scope for 2-week POC; offer temporary scoped creds with audit trail.

sam k: I'll add a mapping README for nested JSON and a small redaction harness. Proposed redaction check: 300 blind rows, target recall >= 96%. Latency goal: p95 < 400ms for golden prompts.

sales-bot: Prefill security questionnaire: https://redwood.internal/sec/prefill/beacon-poc-2026.

infra-bot: Ticket JOB-POC-9001 created (owners: rob m, sam k). Checklist: create-bucket, attach-kms, share-creds, run-redaction-harness. Due: 1825004800.

elaine s: Pricing ask: customer requested zero-rating. Propose $1k credit + discounted overage. I'll confirm. Action items: elaine send sample schema + NDA addendum; rob create bucket; sam run initial redaction pass. Reconvene tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
